descripcion: Workplaces and training places with their real hazards: car workshop, joinery and metal workshop, warehouse and logistics, factory, laboratory, professional kitchen and the inside of a building site.

banco_trabajo_tornillo.descripcion: Sheet-metal bench at hip height against the wall. An iron vice sticks out from the front edge: your hand or hip finds it before the cane does.
banco_trabajo_tornillo.imagen: Footprint of “Workbench with vice”: a rectangle with a lug sticking out at the front left: the vice, 1.80 by 0.85 metres, marked with the letters “Bt”.

carro_herramientas.descripcion: Wheeled sheet-metal trolley full of drawers, waist high. It is heavy, but push it and it rolls. Open drawers stick out.
carro_herramientas.imagen: Footprint of “Tool trolley with drawers”: a rectangle, 0.75 by 0.46 metres, marked with the letters “Ch”.

panel_herramientas.descripcion: Pegboard on the wall, from waist to head, with spanners and hammers hanging and sticking out. The cane passes underneath.
panel_herramientas.imagen: Footprint of “Wall tool board”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.10 metres, hanging 0.95 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Ph”.

camilla_mecanico.descripcion: Low board on small castors for sliding under a car. It sits a hand's width off the floor and shoots away if you step on it.
camilla_mecanico.imagen: Footprint of “Mechanic's creeper”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 0.45 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Cm”.

elevador_dos_columnas.descripcion: Two steel posts, one on each side, with four swinging arms at floor level: with the lift down you trip over them. A low plate crosses the floor between the posts.
elevador_dos_columnas.aviso: Car lift: arms at floor level and, when raised, a car at head height.
elevador_dos_columnas.imagen: Footprint of “Two-post car lift”: two columns at the sides, joined by a floor plate, with four arms spread like an X, 3.40 by 2.40 metres, marked with the letters “Ed”.

coche_en_elevador.descripcion: A whole car raised on the lift: its underside is at head height. The cane finds nothing below; oil drips and you hear the mechanic working.
coche_en_elevador.imagen: Footprint of “Car raised on the lift”: the outline of a vehicle, nose at the front, 1.80 by 4.30 metres, hanging 1.60 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Ce”.

foso_taller.descripcion: A long, narrow trench in the floor for working under cars, with a low iron rim. With no car over it, it is an open hole one and a half metres deep.
foso_taller.aviso: Inspection pit: a deep hole in the floor. Stop.
foso_taller.imagen: Footprint of “Inspection pit”: a rectangle, 0.90 by 5.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ft”.

gato_carretilla.descripcion: Low, heavy jack on wheels, left on the floor. Its body does not reach the ankle; the long handle stands up at hip height.
gato_carretilla.imagen: Footprint of “Trolley jack”: a T shape, 0.35 by 1.30 metres, marked with the letters “Gc”.

caballete_coche.descripcion: Low iron tripod, shin high, left under the car or loose on the floor. It is heavy and does not move aside.
caballete_coche.imagen: Footprint of “Axle stand”: a triangle, 0.25 by 0.25 metres, marked with the letters “Cc”.

grua_pluma_motores.descripcion: Wheeled workshop crane: two long, low legs spreading in a V along the floor and an arm above with a chain and a hanging hook.
grua_pluma_motores.imagen: Footprint of “Engine crane”: a V: the mast at the back and two long legs spreading to the front, 1.00 by 1.60 metres, marked with the letters “Gp”.

desmontadora_neumaticos.descripcion: Machine with a turntable at knee height and a column behind with an arm sticking out at the top. There are pedals on the floor.
desmontadora_neumaticos.imagen: Footprint of “Tyre changer”: a T shape, 1.00 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Dn”.

equilibradora_ruedas.descripcion: Sheet-metal cabinet at waist height with a shaft sticking out of one side where the wheel is fitted. It beeps when the spin ends.
equilibradora_ruedas.imagen: Footprint of “Wheel balancer”: an L shape, 1.10 by 0.75 metres, marked with the letters “Er”.

pila_neumaticos.descripcion: Tyres stacked on top of each other: a round rubber column, soft to the knock and strong-smelling. There is a hollow inside.
pila_neumaticos.imagen: Footprint of “Stack of tyres”: a circle, 0.65 by 0.65 metres, marked with the letters “Pn”.

estante_neumaticos.descripcion: Tubular frame with two or three rows of tyres standing side by side. The tyres on the bottom row stick out beyond the tubes.
estante_neumaticos.imagen: Footprint of “Tyre rack”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “En”.

compresor_aire.descripcion: A rounded air tank lying on its side with the motor on top. Noisy: it starts on its own and chugs; you hear it all over the workshop, a good landmark.
compresor_aire.imagen: Footprint of “Workshop air compressor”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 0.50 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Ca”.

enrollador_manguera_aire.descripcion: A reel fixed to the wall or ceiling with a rubber hose and its gun hanging at chest height. It swings when touched; the cane gives no warning.
enrollador_manguera_aire.imagen: Footprint of “Hanging air hose reel”: a rectangle, 0.40 by 0.25 metres, hanging 1.20 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Em”.

bidon_aceite.descripcion: Round sheet-metal drum, waist high. Full, it sounds solid; empty, it booms like a drum.
bidon_aceite.imagen: Footprint of “200-litre oil drum”: a circle, 0.58 by 0.58 metres, marked with the letters “Ba”.

recogedor_aceite.descripcion: Round wheeled tank with a thin tube rising to a wide funnel at face height. Narrow at the bottom; the funnel sticks out at the top.
recogedor_aceite.imagen: Footprint of “Waste oil drainer with funnel”: a circle, 0.50 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Ra”.

cargador_baterias.descripcion: Heavy box on wheels with two thick cables and clamps trailing on the floor. It hums while charging.
cargador_baterias.imagen: Footprint of “Battery charger on a trolley”: a rectangle, 0.40 by 0.35 metres, marked with the letters “Cb”.

sierra_mesa.descripcion: Iron table at hip height with a saw blade poking up in the middle. When running it screams: keep away from the table.
sierra_mesa.imagen: Footprint of “Table saw”: a rectangle, 0.90 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Sm”.

sierra_cinta.descripcion: Tall, narrow machine, like a cabinet open at the front, with a small table at waist height where the blade comes down.
sierra_cinta.imagen: Footprint of “Band saw”: an upside-down T: the column at the back and a wide table at the front, 0.75 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Sc”.

cepilladora.descripcion: Long, low machine with two smooth iron tables in a row at hip height. Timber comes out at one end: do not stand behind it.
cepilladora.imagen: Footprint of “Planer”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 2.20 metres, marked with the letters “Ce”.

torno_madera.descripcion: Long, narrow bed at chest height with the workpiece spinning between two centres. Shavings fly to the front.
torno_madera.imagen: Footprint of “Wood lathe”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Tm”.

lijadora_banda.descripcion: Machine with a long sanding belt at waist height. When running it rasps with a loud hiss and raises dust.
lijadora_banda.imagen: Footprint of “Floor-standing belt sander”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 1.30 metres, marked with the letters “Lb”.

aspirador_virutas.nombre: Chip extractor with bag and hose
aspirador_virutas.descripcion: Wheeled motor with two cloth bags, one inflated above and one below. A wide flexible hose runs from it across the floor to the machine: a trip hazard.
aspirador_virutas.imagen: Footprint of “Chip extractor with bag and hose”: a teardrop, round at the back and pointed at the front, 0.60 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Av”.

banco_carpintero.descripcion: Solid wooden bench at hip height, with a wooden vice sticking out at one corner and a low shelf.
banco_carpintero.imagen: Footprint of “Joiner's bench with vices”: a rectangle with a lug sticking out at the front left: the vice, 2.00 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Bc”.

tablero_caballetes.descripcion: A big board resting on two trestles. The board overhangs at the sides: the cane goes underneath and your hip hits the edge.
tablero_caballetes.imagen: Footprint of “Board on trestles”: a rectangle, 2.44 by 1.22 metres, marked with the letters “Tc”.

tablones_pared.descripcion: Long planks standing on end, leaning on the wall: the foot stands a couple of hand-widths out and the top touches it. Push them and they slide and fall.
tablones_pared.imagen: Footprint of “Planks leaning against the wall”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Tp”.

carro_tableros.descripcion: Long wheeled trolley carrying boards on edge, almost upright. The boards stick out beyond both ends of the trolley.
carro_tableros.imagen: Footprint of “Board trolley”: a rectangle with cut corners, 0.80 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ct”.

monton_serrin.descripcion: Sawdust piled on the floor by the machines. You walk on it: it is soft, muffles your steps and slides on a smooth floor.
monton_serrin.imagen: Footprint of “Heap of sawdust and shavings”: an oval, 1.20 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ms”.

sargentos_colgados.descripcion: A row of iron clamps hanging from a rail on the wall, from chest to head. They stick out and clink when brushed; the cane passes underneath.
sargentos_colgados.imagen: Footprint of “Clamps hanging from a rail”: a rectangle, 1.00 by 0.20 metres, hanging 1.10 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Sc”.

taladro_columna.descripcion: Iron column on a heavy base, with a small table at waist height and the motor head at face height, sticking out to the front.
taladro_columna.imagen: Footprint of “Pillar drill”: a rectangle, 0.45 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Tc”.

esmeril_banco.descripcion: Motor with two grinding wheels on an iron pedestal at waist height. When running it throws sparks to the front and the workpiece gets hot.
esmeril_banco.imagen: Footprint of “Bench grinder on a pedestal”: a T shape, 0.50 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Eb”.

torno_metal.descripcion: Long, heavy machine with its bed at waist height. Handwheels and levers stick out at the front; the chuck spins at one end.
torno_metal.imagen: Footprint of “Metal lathe”: a rectangle, 2.20 by 0.90 metres, marked with the letters “Tm”.

fresadora_columna.descripcion: A thick column at the back and, in front, a wide table at waist height that travels sideways and sticks out beyond the machine body.
fresadora_columna.imagen: Footprint of “Milling machine”: an upside-down T: the column at the back and a wide table at the front, 1.50 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Fc”.

plegadora_chapa.descripcion: Long machine at waist height with a front bar that lifts to bend the sheet. Counterweights stick out at both ends.
plegadora_chapa.imagen: Footprint of “Sheet metal folder”: a rectangle, 2.50 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Pc”.

cizalla_chapa.descripcion: Wide machine with a table in front at waist height and a pedal bar at floor level across its whole width: your foot finds it before your hand.
cizalla_chapa.imagen: Footprint of “Sheet metal guillotine”: a rectangle, 2.60 by 1.80 metres, marked with the letters “Cc”.

equipo_soldadura.descripcion: Welding machine on wheels with its gas bottle behind and thick cables on the floor. While welding it buzzes and crackles, and the weld stays hot for a good while.
equipo_soldadura.imagen: Footprint of “Welding set on a trolley”: a rectangle, 0.50 by 0.90 metres, marked with the letters “Es”.

pantalla_soldadura.descripcion: A heavy canvas screen on a tubular frame with feet sticking out at the sides. It is light: push it and it moves. Someone is welding behind it.
pantalla_soldadura.imagen: Footprint of “Welding screen”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Ps”.

mesa_soldadura.descripcion: Table of thick steel plate, full of holes, at hip height. It is hot after welding: do not rest your hand on it.
mesa_soldadura.imagen: Footprint of “Welding table”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Ms”.

yunque_tocon.descripcion: Solid iron anvil on a wooden stump, at hip height. At one end it tapers into a pointed horn that sticks out beyond the stump.
yunque_tocon.imagen: Footprint of “Anvil on a stump”: a round block (the stump) with a point on the right (the horn) and a lug on the left, 0.70 by 0.45 metres, marked with the letters “Yt”.

fragua_forja.descripcion: Iron table with a hollow full of embers and a blower underneath. When lit you feel the heat a step away and hear the air feeding the fire.
fragua_forja.imagen: Footprint of “Forge hearth”: a rectangle with cut corners, 1.00 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ff”.

estante_perfiles.descripcion: Columns with iron arms reaching forwards at several heights, loaded with long bars and tubes. There is a gap between columns: the cane goes in and the arms are above it.
estante_perfiles.imagen: Footprint of “Cantilever rack for bars”: a comb: a bar with bodies sticking out to the front, 4.00 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Ep”.

perfiles_sobresalen.nombre: Bars sticking out of the rack
perfiles_sobresalen.descripcion: Ends of long tubes and bars sticking out of the rack into the aisle at head height. The cane misses them: they are iron and sharp-edged.
perfiles_sobresalen.imagen: Footprint of “Bars sticking out of the rack”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 0.80 metres, hanging 1.50 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Ps”.

chapas_apoyadas.descripcion: Iron A-frame shaped like a roof with large sheets leaning on both sides. The edges cut: explore it with the cane, not your hand.
chapas_apoyadas.imagen: Footprint of “Metal sheets on an A-frame”: a trapezoid, narrower at the back, 1.00 by 2.50 metres, marked with the letters “Ca”.

estanteria_pales.descripcion: Tall perforated-steel frames (the uprights) joined by beams, with pallets at several levels. Down low the cane finds the feet of the uprights and the floor pallet; the beams and upper pallets are above your head. Knock it and it booms.
estanteria_pales.imagen: Footprint of “Pallet racking”: a rectangle, 2.70 by 1.10 metres, marked with the letters “Ep”.

estanteria_picking.descripcion: Steel-shelved racking, the lowest shelf a hand's width off the floor, full of plastic bins open towards the aisle. The bins stick out beyond the shelves and your hand finds them before the cane does.
estanteria_picking.imagen: Footprint of “Medium-duty shelving with picking bins”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Ep”.

estanteria_dinamica.descripcion: Shelving with roller shelves sloping down towards the aisle: the boxes roll forwards by themselves. Take one and you hear the next one roll and knock against the stop. The front is lower than the back.
estanteria_dinamica.imagen: Footprint of “Carton flow rack”: a rectangle, 1.80 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ed”.

pale_sobresale_estante.descripcion: A pallet badly placed on the first level of the rack, sticking out into the aisle at face height. The cane finds nothing below it: wooden boards and hard-cornered boxes.
pale_sobresale_estante.imagen: Footprint of “Pallet overhanging the rack”: a rectangle, 1.00 by 0.40 metres, hanging 1.60 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Ps”.

pales_vacios.descripcion: Empty wooden pallets, single or stacked. One alone on the floor is a hand-high step with gaps between the boards that catch your foot; stacked, they are a block that sounds hollow. The boards splinter.
pales_vacios.imagen: Footprint of “Empty pallets”: a rectangle, 0.80 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Pv”.

jaula_rejilla.descripcion: Steel mesh cage on four feet, waist high, stackable. The cold mesh lets your fingers through; one side has a half door that folds outwards.
jaula_rejilla.imagen: Footprint of “Wire mesh pallet cage”: a rectangle, 0.84 by 1.24 metres, marked with the letters “Jr”.

contenedor_ibc.descripcion: Cube-shaped thick plastic tank inside a cage of steel bars, on a pallet, chest high. A tap sticks out low at the front at shin height; empty, it booms like a drum.
contenedor_ibc.imagen: Footprint of “1000-litre IBC tank”: a rectangle, 1.00 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Ci”.

bobina_chapa.descripcion: A coil of sheet steel lying on a wooden or iron cradle. It weighs several tonnes and does not move; the sheet edges cut. From one side you can feel the round hole in the middle.
bobina_chapa.imagen: Footprint of “Steel coil on a cradle”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Bc”.

transpaleta_manual.descripcion: Two low steel forks, a hand high, and a handle standing up at chest height. The floor-level forks trip you and the handle falls towards you if touched. Pumping the handle raises the forks.
transpaleta_manual.imagen: Footprint of “Hand pallet truck”: a short head at the back and two long forks to the front with a gap between them, 0.54 by 1.55 metres, marked with the letters “Tm”.

transpaleta_electrica.descripcion: A large powered pallet truck: a sheet-metal body at waist height with the tiller and a folding platform where the driver stands. Running, it beeps, hums and moves by itself; the forks lead at floor level.
transpaleta_electrica.imagen: Footprint of “Electric pallet truck with platform”: a short head at the back and two long forks to the front with a gap between them, 0.80 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Te”.

carretilla_elevadora.descripcion: Heavy four-wheeled machine with the seat under a roof of bars. At the front, the mast and two steel forks at floor level sticking out over a metre: you trip on them before you reach the machine. Running, it beeps and reverses with no further warning.
carretilla_elevadora.aviso: Forklift: the forks stick out at the front at floor level.
carretilla_elevadora.imagen: Footprint of “Forklift with forks lowered”: a rectangular body at the back and two narrow forks sticking out to the front, 1.15 by 3.40 metres, marked with the letters “Ce”.

horquillas_en_alto.descripcion: A forklift's forks raised, with or without a pallet, at head height. The cane finds nothing below: two thick steel bars with wedge-shaped tips.
horquillas_en_alto.imagen: Footprint of “Raised forklift forks”: two long forks sticking out to the front from a cross bar, 0.90 by 1.20 metres, hanging 1.50 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “He”.

carro_plataforma.descripcion: Low sheet-metal platform on four castors, shin high, with a tubular handle at one end at hip height. Empty, the platform trips you; loaded, the goods stick out at the sides.
carro_plataforma.imagen: Footprint of “Platform hand truck”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 0.90 metres, marked with the letters “Cp”.

carro_preparacion_pedidos.descripcion: Tall multi-shelf trolley with boxes, sometimes with a folding step for reaching up. It is pushed by a handle at chest height; the step sticks out at the front at shin height.
carro_preparacion_pedidos.imagen: Footprint of “Order picking trolley”: a rectangle, 0.70 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Cp”.

escalera_almacen_plataforma.descripcion: Ladder with wide treads, handrails and a platform at the top, on wheels that lock when you step on the first tread. At the back it is a sloping frame: the cane goes underneath and your head meets the upper treads.
escalera_almacen_plataforma.imagen: Footprint of “Warehouse platform ladder”: a rectangle, 0.80 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Ea”.

cinta_transportadora.descripcion: A rubber belt running over rollers at hip height between two steel side rails. Running, it hums and carries off anything placed on it; underneath there are legs and open space. A stop at the end.
cinta_transportadora.imagen: Footprint of “Belt conveyor”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 5.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ct”.

curva_transportadora.descripcion: A section of conveyor that turns through a quarter circle at hip height. Following the outer edge with your hand you feel the bend; in the inner corner of the curve the cane goes in under the belt.
curva_transportadora.imagen: Footprint of “Conveyor curve”: a quarter-turn band, with the centre of the bend at the back left, 1.60 by 1.60 metres, marked with the letters “Ct”.

enfardadora_pales.descripcion: Round steel turntable a hand's width off the floor, with a tall column behind it where the film carriage travels up and down. Running, the turntable spins with the pallet on it and the film squeals as it stretches: the edge sweeps past your feet.
enfardadora_pales.imagen: Footprint of “Pallet stretch wrapper”: a round turntable with a column attached at the back, 1.65 by 1.90 metres, marked with the letters “Ep”.

bascula_plataforma.descripcion: A square steel plate a hand's width off the floor, with a short ramp for running the pallet truck on and a display on a post beside it at chest height. It sounds hollow underfoot and you feel the edge of the ramp.
bascula_plataforma.imagen: Footprint of “Pallet platform scale”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Bp”.

borde_muelle_carga.descripcion: The warehouse floor ends abruptly at the dock: over a metre below is the lorry yard. Sometimes there are rubber bumpers or a chain; with the door open and no lorry, it is a drop. The outside air warns you.
borde_muelle_carga.aviso: Edge of the loading dock: over a metre's drop. Stop.
borde_muelle_carga.imagen: Footprint of “Loading dock edge”: a rectangle, 3.00 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Bm”.

rampa_niveladora.descripcion: A ridged steel plate set into the floor at the dock edge. Lowered, it is floor and sounds hollow underfoot; raised, its lip lifts, the plate slopes and a step appears at the sides.
rampa_niveladora.imagen: Footprint of “Dock leveller”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 3.00 metres, marked with the letters “Rn”.

puerta_seccional.descripcion: Panelled door that runs up to the ceiling on side tracks, framed outside by a padded canvas shelter. Closed, it is a cold steel wall; opening, it rattles and the air and noise of the yard come in.
puerta_seccional.imagen: Footprint of “Dock sectional door with shelter”: a rectangle, 3.00 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Ps”.

escalera_muelle_carga.descripcion: A flight of four or five steps, concrete or metal grating, against one side of the dock for going down to the yard. It has a handrail on one side; the other may be open to the dock drop.
escalera_muelle_carga.aviso: Steps down from the dock to the yard.
escalera_muelle_carga.imagen: Footprint of “Loading dock steps”: a rectangle, 1.00 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Em”.

protector_puntal.descripcion: A thick U-shaped steel guard, shin high, bolted to the floor around the foot of each upright. The cane finds it early and tells you a rack begins; step on it and you trip.
protector_puntal.imagen: Footprint of “Rack upright protector”: a U open at the back, hugging the foot of the upright, 0.20 by 0.20 metres, marked with the letters “Pp”.

barrera_peatonal_almacen.descripcion: Thick tubular or polymer handrail at hip height with a low rail, bolted to the floor to separate the walkway from the forklift lanes. You can follow it by hand; it has gaps at the crossings.
barrera_peatonal_almacen.imagen: Footprint of “Pedestrian walkway barrier”: a rectangle, 3.00 by 0.20 metres, marked with the letters “Bp”.

baliza_cruce_carretillas.descripcion: A post with a rotating light and a buzzer that beeps when a forklift approaches a crossing or a door. It is a sound landmark: if it beeps, wait.
baliza_cruce_carretillas.imagen: Footprint of “Forklift crossing warning beacon”: a circle, 0.15 by 0.15 metres, marked with the letters “Bc”.

cortina_lamas.descripcion: Strips of thick, soft plastic hanging from the lintel to the floor, overlapping. You go through by pushing: they brush your face and shoulders and close behind you. The cane slips between them almost unnoticed.
cortina_lamas.imagen: Footprint of “PVC strip curtain”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 0.05 metres, marked with the letters “Cl”.

prensa_hidraulica.descripcion: Tall, massive machine like an iron cabinet open at the front, with its bed at waist height. Each cycle gives a dull thud and a hiss of air; in front there is a light curtain you cannot feel that stops it if you put your hand in.
prensa_hidraulica.imagen: Footprint of “Production hydraulic press”: a rectangle, 1.80 by 1.60 metres, marked with the letters “Ph”.

inyectora_plastico.descripcion: Very long machine at chest height, closed with sliding guards. At one end, up high, the hopper where the plastic goes in; at the other, the parts drop into a box. The oil hisses, the mould thumps and the hopper area is hot.
inyectora_plastico.imagen: Footprint of “Plastic injection moulding machine”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 6.00 metres, marked with the letters “Ip”.

telar_industrial.descripcion: Wide iron machine at chest height with the cloth roller at the front and hundreds of taut threads behind. It makes a very fast clack-clack that fills the hall: you have to shout, and each loom is told apart by where its sound comes from.
telar_industrial.imagen: Footprint of “Industrial loom”: a rectangle, 3.00 by 1.80 metres, marked with the letters “Ti”.

celda_robot.descripcion: An enclosure of steel mesh panels taller than you, with a door that stops the robot when opened. Inside, an arm that swings and welds: it buzzes, crackles and moves without warning. From outside you can follow the mesh by hand.
celda_robot.imagen: Footprint of “Fenced robot cell”: a rectangle, 4.00 by 4.00 metres, marked with the letters “Cr”.

centro_mecanizado.descripcion: A machine like a person-high sheet-metal booth, with a glass sliding door at the front and a button panel on an arm sticking out at one side. Inside, the tool spins with a whine and sprays coolant: the floor in front is slippery.
centro_mecanizado.imagen: Footprint of “CNC machining centre”: a rectangle, 2.60 by 2.40 metres, marked with the letters “Cm”.

horno_industrial.descripcion: Huge sheet-metal cabinet with two thick doors; walking past you feel the heat and the front panel is hot. Inside you hear the fan. Opening it releases a blast of hot air.
horno_industrial.imagen: Footprint of “Industrial drying oven”: a rectangle, 2.00 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Hi”.

maquina_coser_industrial.descripcion: A one-metre table with the sewing machine on top, a pedal on the floor and the motor hanging under the top, where your knees hit it. They usually stand in rows, one behind another, each rattling as it sews.
maquina_coser_industrial.imagen: Footprint of “Industrial sewing machine table”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Mc”.

linea_montaje.descripcion: A long conveyor at the back and, in front, work tables separated by gaps, one per person. Following the table edges you can count the stations; in the gaps the cane reaches the moving belt.
linea_montaje.imagen: Footprint of “Assembly line with workstations”: a comb: a bar with bodies sticking out to the front, 8.00 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Lm”.

puesto_montaje.descripcion: Work table at waist height with a frame behind: sloping shelves of parts bins overhanging the table at face height, and a tool hanging from a spring balancer down to hand height.
puesto_montaje.imagen: Footprint of “Assembly workstation with bin shelf”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 0.90 metres, marked with the letters “Pm”.

taburete_puesto.descripcion: Tall stool with a hard, adjustable seat, a small backrest and a foot ring halfway up. If it has castors it rolls away when you lean on it; the ring trips you.
taburete_puesto.imagen: Footprint of “Tall workstation stool”: a circle, 0.50 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Tp”.

contenedor_virutas.descripcion: Wedge-shaped steel hopper, hip high, on feet with slots for the forks. Its mouth is wide at the front; inside there are metal chips that cut and smell of coolant.
contenedor_virutas.imagen: Footprint of “Self-dumping chip hopper”: a rectangle, 1.00 by 1.20 metres, marked with the letters “Cv”.

tuberia_aerea.descripcion: A pipe, duct or cable tray crossing the way, hung from the ceiling at forehead height. The cane misses it and it makes no sound until you walk into it; sometimes it is padded with foam.
tuberia_aerea.imagen: Footprint of “Low pipe crossing overhead”: a rectangle, 3.00 by 0.20 metres, hanging 1.80 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Ta”.

puente_grua_gancho.descripcion: A steel hook hanging on chains or cables from the overhead crane that runs along the hall roof. It can hang at face height and it swings; when the crane moves a bell rings and the trolley rolls overhead.
puente_grua_gancho.aviso: Crane hook hanging at face height.
puente_grua_gancho.imagen: Footprint of “Overhead crane hook”: a circle, 0.30 by 0.30 metres, hanging 1.60 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Pg”.

brazo_aspiracion_humos.descripcion: An articulated tube coming out of the wall or a column and ending in a small hood at face height, over the welding table or the lab bench. It moves if you push it and, when on, it sucks with a low rumble.
brazo_aspiracion_humos.imagen: Footprint of “Fume extraction arm”: a rectangle, 0.40 by 2.00 metres, hanging 1.50 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Ba”.

armario_electrico_fabrica.descripcion: Tall sheet-metal cabinet against a wall or a machine, with a beacon on top and a buzzer that beeps when something fails. Its open door sticks out at face height; inside it hums.
armario_electrico_fabrica.imagen: Footprint of “Electrical control cabinet”: a rectangle, 0.80 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Ae”.

ventilador_industrial.descripcion: A huge caged fan on a splayed-leg stand or castors, at head height. You feel its air stream from afar and its rumble is a good landmark; the legs spread out to the sides.
ventilador_industrial.imagen: Footprint of “Industrial pedestal fan”: a circle, 0.90 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Vi”.

puerta_rapida.descripcion: Thick, flexible canvas that rolls up and down in a few seconds between two steel guides when a forklift approaches or a cord is pulled. If it comes down on you it pushes and goes back up; the guides stick out a hand's width from the wall.
puerta_rapida.imagen: Footprint of “High-speed roll-up door”: a rectangle, 3.00 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Pr”.

reloj_fichar.descripcion: A box on the wall at chest height with a reader for your card; it beeps when you clock in. It is usually at the entrance to the hall, next to a notice board: a good landmark for the door.
reloj_fichar.imagen: Footprint of “Time clock”: a rectangle, 0.25 by 0.10 metres, hanging 1.20 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Rf”.

pulsador_seta_emergencia.nombre: Emergency stop button on a post
pulsador_seta_emergencia.descripcion: A slim post at waist height with a big round button on top, like a mushroom: pressing it stops the machine or the line. The wide, smooth mushroom is easy to find without looking.
pulsador_seta_emergencia.imagen: Footprint of “Emergency stop button on a post”: a circle, 0.12 by 0.12 metres, marked with the letters “Ps”.

armario_epis.descripcion: A person-high sheet-metal cabinet by the entrance to the hall, holding helmets, goggles, earplugs and gloves. When open, its doors stick out at face height.
armario_epis.imagen: Footprint of “PPE cabinet”: a rectangle, 1.00 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Ae”.

poyata_mural.descripcion: A continuous lab bench against the wall with a cold, smooth top and cupboards underneath. Above it, a shelf of reagent bottles at face height overhanging the bench; on the upstand, gas and vacuum taps sticking out.
poyata_mural.imagen: Footprint of “Wall laboratory bench”: a rectangle, 3.00 by 0.75 metres, marked with the letters “Pm”.

mesa_antivibratoria.descripcion: A low, very heavy table with a polished stone slab resting on its frame: push it and nothing moves. On it, the balance in its glass draught shield; here people speak quietly and lean on nothing.
mesa_antivibratoria.imagen: Footprint of “Anti-vibration balance table”: a rectangle, 1.00 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Ma”.

fregadero_laboratorio.descripcion: A deep sink in the bench with a tall swan-neck tap and, on the wall above, a pegboard where glassware drains at face height: the pegs and glass stick out and break easily.
fregadero_laboratorio.imagen: Footprint of “Lab sink with pegboard drainer”: a rectangle, 1.00 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Fl”.

cabina_seguridad_biologica.descripcion: Tall steel unit with a sloping glass front leaving a slot at chest height to put your arms in. Its fan blows with a constant rumble; you work seated and the stand has feet that stick out.
cabina_seguridad_biologica.imagen: Footprint of “Biological safety cabinet”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Cs”.

centrifuga_laboratorio.descripcion: A rounded machine with its lid on top: small ones on the bench, large ones on the floor at hip height. Starting up, its whine rises until it is high and steady; when it finishes it beeps and winds down slowly. While spinning, the lid stays locked.
centrifuga_laboratorio.imagen: Footprint of “Laboratory centrifuge”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 0.70 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Cl”.

autoclave_laboratorio.descripcion: A huge steel pressure vessel: the upright kind has a lid on top with a handwheel; the horizontal kind, a round door at the front. It hisses and vents steam at the end of the cycle; the casing and door are hot.
autoclave_laboratorio.imagen: Footprint of “Laboratory autoclave”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 0.70 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Al”.

congelador_ultra.descripcion: A tall, wide freezer cabinet with a thick lever-handled door. It hums loudly and blows warm air out at the bottom; what is inside burns with cold and is not touched without gloves.
congelador_ultra.imagen: Footprint of “Ultra-low freezer”: a rectangle, 0.90 by 0.90 metres, marked with the letters “Cu”.

tanque_nitrogeno.descripcion: A thick, round steel vessel on a wheeled base, hip or chest high. It hisses softly and, when opened, a very cold mist spills out onto the floor. It burns with cold.
tanque_nitrogeno.imagen: Footprint of “Liquid nitrogen dewar on wheels”: a circle, 0.60 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Tn”.

estufa_cultivo.descripcion: Chest-high steel cabinet with an inner glass door; it is warm inside and hums quietly. There are often two stacked one on top of the other, and the open door ends up at face height.
estufa_cultivo.imagen: Footprint of “Laboratory incubator”: a rectangle, 0.70 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Ec”.

destilador_pared.descripcion: A glass and steel apparatus hung on the wall above the bench at face height: glass tubes and coils that stick out, boil and drip. It is hot and fragile; the cane misses it.
destilador_pared.imagen: Footprint of “Wall-mounted water still”: a rectangle, 0.50 by 0.25 metres, hanging 1.20 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Dp”.

lavadora_material_vidrio.descripcion: A steel machine under the bench or freestanding, like a large dishwasher. Its door drops down at knee height into the walkway, with the glassware racks pulled out. It washes with jets and lets out steam when opened.
lavadora_material_vidrio.imagen: Footprint of “Laboratory glassware washer”: a rectangle, 0.65 by 0.65 metres, marked with the letters “Lm”.

armario_seguridad_quimicos.descripcion: A very heavy thick-steel cabinet with self-closing doors and a ventilation pipe coming out of the top. Inside, bottles and cans in sumps. The doors do not stay open: they push back when released.
armario_seguridad_quimicos.imagen: Footprint of “Chemical safety cabinet”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “As”.

ducha_emergencia.descripcion: A tubular post over two metres high with a big shower head above your head and an eyewash bowl sticking out at waist height. It works by pulling a hanging rod: it releases a huge flow and the floor floods.
ducha_emergencia.imagen: Footprint of “Emergency shower with eyewash”: a rectangle, 0.70 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “De”.

botellas_gas_cadena.nombre: Gas cylinders chained to the wall
botellas_gas_cadena.descripcion: A row of gas cylinders nearly as tall as a person, standing against the wall and chained at chest height. Round and cold; knock one and it rings like a bell. The valves at the top stick out.
botellas_gas_cadena.imagen: Footprint of “Gas cylinders chained to the wall”: a rectangle, 0.90 by 0.30 metres, marked with the letters “Bg”.

residuos_quimicos_cubeto.nombre: Chemical waste drums in a spill tray
residuos_quimicos_cubeto.descripcion: Plastic jerrycans and drums with screw caps standing in a low tray with a grating. The tray rim, a hand's width off the floor, trips you; the drums reach from knee to waist.
residuos_quimicos_cubeto.imagen: Footprint of “Chemical waste drums in a spill tray”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Rq”.

cocina_fogones_industrial.descripcion: A steel block at hip height with four or six gas burners and iron grids on top, and the oven door below. When lit the gas roars and you feel the heat a step away; pan handles stick out over the edge.
cocina_fogones_industrial.imagen: Footprint of “Commercial range with oven”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.90 metres, marked with the letters “Cf”.

freidora_industrial.descripcion: A narrow steel unit at hip height with one or two oil wells and the baskets hanging above. It sizzles when frying; the oil and the rim burn and the floor around it is slippery.
freidora_industrial.imagen: Footprint of “Commercial deep fryer”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 0.90 metres, marked with the letters “Fi”.

plancha_cocina.descripcion: A thick steel griddle on a cabinet at hip height, with a grease channel at the front. When food goes on it sizzles and smokes; it burns without your noticing from a distance.
plancha_cocina.imagen: Footprint of “Commercial griddle”: a rectangle, 0.80 by 0.90 metres, marked with the letters “Pc”.

marmita_industrial.descripcion: A giant round double-walled steel pot on legs, its rim at waist height, with a hinged lid. Tilting ones have a handwheel sticking out at one side. It boils with a deep bubbling and gives off steam.
marmita_industrial.imagen: Footprint of “Boiling pan”: a circle, 1.00 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Mi”.

horno_mixto.descripcion: A chest-high steel cabinet on a stand, with a thick glass door that opens towards you and releases a cloud of hot steam. The fan hums inside; it beeps when done.
horno_mixto.imagen: Footprint of “Combi steam oven”: a rectangle, 0.90 by 0.85 metres, marked with the letters “Hm”.

campana_extractora_cocina.descripcion: A big steel box hanging over the burners, its lower edge at forehead height: it sticks out in front of the cooking line and your head hits its edge. Its fan roars and masks other sounds.
campana_extractora_cocina.aviso: Extractor hood: its edge is at forehead height.
campana_extractora_cocina.imagen: Footprint of “Commercial kitchen extractor hood”: a rectangle, 3.00 by 1.10 metres, hanging 1.95 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Ce”.

fogon_bajo.descripcion: A very low iron burner at knee height for huge pots that do not fit on top. When lit the flame roars and the heat rises to your face; the cane knocks against its iron legs.
fogon_bajo.imagen: Footprint of “Low stock-pot range”: a rectangle, 0.60 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Fb”.

salamandra_gratinador.descripcion: A steel grill hung on the wall above the range at face height. The elements inside radiate heat; its front edge sticks out and burns.
salamandra_gratinador.imagen: Footprint of “Wall-mounted salamander grill”: a rectangle, 0.80 by 0.50 metres, hanging 1.40 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Sg”.

mesa_refrigerada.descripcion: A steel table at hip height with fridge doors underneath. It hums, blows warm air out at the bottom and its doors block the way when opened.
mesa_refrigerada.imagen: Footprint of “Under-counter refrigerated table”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Mr”.

armario_refrigerado.descripcion: A person-high steel cabinet with one or two thick doors that close by themselves on their seals. You hear the compressor and, when opened, cold air hits your face.
armario_refrigerado.imagen: Footprint of “Commercial upright refrigerator”: a rectangle, 1.40 by 0.85 metres, marked with the letters “Ar”.

abatidor_temperatura.descripcion: A steel cabinet that chills food very fast: its fan roars louder than a fridge's and the door is thick and heavy. Inside, runners with trays.
abatidor_temperatura.imagen: Footprint of “Blast chiller”: a rectangle, 0.80 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “At”.

lavavajillas_capota.descripcion: A steel table leading to a box with a hood you pull down by a handle: inside, the rack is washed in a minute with jets. Lifting the hood lets hot steam into your face and the floor around is wet.
lavavajillas_capota.imagen: Footprint of “Hood dishwasher with tables”: an L: the inlet table along the wall and the machine with the outlet table in the corner, coming forwards, 2.80 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Lc”.

tren_lavado.descripcion: A very long steel machine at chest height through which the racks travel on a conveyor between rubber curtains. It roars, splashes and steams at both ends: the sound landmark of the washing area.
tren_lavado.imagen: Footprint of “Conveyor dishwasher”: a rectangle, 5.00 by 0.90 metres, marked with the letters “Tl”.

fregadero_industrial.descripcion: A steel sink with one or two very deep bowls at hip height and a tall spring tap with a spray head hanging at face height: it swings and drips. Underneath, the cane reaches in as far as the legs.
fregadero_industrial.imagen: Footprint of “Commercial sink with pre-rinse spray”: a rectangle, 1.60 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Fi”.

mesa_trabajo_inox.descripcion: A steel table at hip height with a low shelf and, if against the wall, an upstand at the back. Cold and smooth with sharp corners; the bottom shelf sticks out a little and the cane hits it.
mesa_trabajo_inox.imagen: Footprint of “Stainless-steel work table”: a rectangle, 1.60 by 0.70 metres, marked with the letters “Mt”.

estante_mural_inox.nombre: Wall shelf above the work table
estante_mural_inox.descripcion: A steel shelf bolted to the wall above the work table at face height, full of containers. Leaning over the table you bump your head on it; the cane misses it.
estante_mural_inox.imagen: Footprint of “Wall shelf above the work table”: a rectangle, 1.60 by 0.35 metres, hanging 1.45 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Em”.

amasadora_espiral.descripcion: A floor-standing machine at waist height with a round steel bowl and a head above that drives the hook. Running, it growls and the dough thumps; the bowl turns and hands must stay out.
amasadora_espiral.imagen: Footprint of “Spiral dough mixer”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 0.60 by 0.90 metres, marked with the letters “Ae”.

barra_utensilios_colgados.descripcion: A steel rail over the table or the burners with ladles, skimmers and pans hanging at face height. They clink when brushed and some are hot; the cane passes underneath.
barra_utensilios_colgados.imagen: Footprint of “Hanging utensil rail”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.15 metres, hanging 1.40 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Bu”.

cubeta_ingredientes.descripcion: A knee-high plastic bin with a sliding lid and castors, kept under the table: flour, sugar or rice. It gets pulled out with a foot and left in the middle of the way.
cubeta_ingredientes.imagen: Footprint of “Ingredient bin on castors”: a rectangle, 0.40 by 0.65 metres, marked with the letters “Ci”.

carro_cestas_lavavajillas.descripcion: A very low square platform, a hand's width off the floor, on castors, for stacking dishwasher racks. Empty, the cane barely finds it and it rolls away when you trip on it.
carro_cestas_lavavajillas.imagen: Footprint of “Dish rack dolly”: a rectangle, 0.55 by 0.55 metres, marked with the letters “Cc”.

estanteria_cocina_ranurada.descripcion: Steel or polymer shelving with slotted shelves, the lowest a hand's width off the floor, loaded with boxes, sacks and tins. In the cold room or kitchen store it forms narrow aisles.
estanteria_cocina_ranurada.imagen: Footprint of “Kitchen shelving with slotted shelves”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Ec”.

canal_desague_cocina.descripcion: A long, narrow steel grating set into the floor from side to side, where the sloping floor drains the water. It sounds metallic underfoot; around it the floor is often wet or greasy.
canal_desague_cocina.imagen: Footprint of “Floor drain channel with grating”: a rectangle, 3.00 by 0.20 metres, marked with the letters “Cd”.

alfombra_goma_drenante.descripcion: A thick rubber mat full of holes in front of the sink or the burners, to stop you slipping. Its bevelled edges form a small step and your foot sinks in slightly.
alfombra_goma_drenante.imagen: Footprint of “Drainage rubber mat”: a rectangle, 0.90 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Ag”.

cubo_pedal_industrial.descripcion: A large hip-high bin with a lid that opens when you step on a pedal sticking out at the front at floor level: your foot trips on it. It smells of scraps and the lid bangs as it drops.
cubo_pedal_industrial.imagen: Footprint of “Wheeled pedal bin”: a rectangle, 0.55 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Cp”.

acopio_ferralla.descripcion: Long, ribbed steel bars piled on the floor on timber blocks or tangled in a heap. The ends stick out in every direction at ankle and shin height: they catch your feet.
acopio_ferralla.imagen: Footprint of “Stockpile of rebar”: an irregular spiky patch, 2.00 by 6.00 metres, marked with the letters “Af”.

esperas_ferralla.descripcion: Steel bars sticking straight up out of the concrete floor, in a cluster or a row, from knee to waist height, waiting for the column or wall. If protected they have a plastic cap on the tip; if not, they stab.
esperas_ferralla.imagen: Footprint of “Rebar starter bars”: a rectangle, 0.40 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Ef”.

mallazo_paneles.descripcion: A pile of welded-wire mesh sheets lying flat on the floor, shin high or lower. If you step on them your foot goes into the squares and the loose ends scratch.
mallazo_paneles.imagen: Footprint of “Stacked steel mesh panels”: a rectangle, 2.15 by 6.00 metres, marked with the letters “Mp”.

tableros_encofrado.nombre: Stack of formwork panels and beams
tableros_encofrado.descripcion: Large timber panels, smooth on one face, stacked next to long timber beams. Low and wide; the beams stick out of the pile and the splinters prick.
tableros_encofrado.imagen: Footprint of “Stack of formwork panels and beams”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 2.50 metres, marked with the letters “Te”.

artesa_mortero.descripcion: A low, wide rubber or steel tub at ankle height, full of mortar or dirty water. Step in and your foot sinks into the mix; around it the floor is splattered and slippery.
artesa_mortero.imagen: Footprint of “Mortar tub”: a rectangle with rounded corners, 0.90 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Am”.

hormigonera_electrica.descripcion: A tilted steel drum on two wheels and legs, chest high, with a handwheel at one side for tipping it. Running, it growls and the gravel rumbles inside; the drum turns and splashes.
hormigonera_electrica.imagen: Footprint of “Site cement mixer”: a round drum with a towing bar sticking out at the back, 0.80 by 1.40 metres, marked with the letters “He”.

cortadora_material_agua.descripcion: An iron table at waist height with a disc that cuts brick or tile and a water tray underneath. Running, it screeches very loudly and sprays slurry; the floor around stays wet.
cortadora_material_agua.imagen: Footprint of “Wet tile and brick saw”: a rectangle, 0.70 by 1.30 metres, marked with the letters “Cm”.

montacargas_obra.descripcion: A steel lattice tower against the façade with a loading platform in front closed by a gate. When the platform is elsewhere, the gate on each floor opens onto a drop; it hums and a bell rings when it moves.
montacargas_obra.aviso: Material hoist: if the platform is not there, the gate opens onto a drop.
montacargas_obra.imagen: Footprint of “Construction material hoist”: an upside-down T: the column at the back and a wide table at the front, 1.60 by 2.00 metres, marked with the letters “Mo”.

base_grua_torre.descripcion: The foot of the crane: an iron lattice tower rising very high from a cross-shaped base with concrete counterweight blocks, fenced off. From below you hear the cables and the slewing motor high above.
base_grua_torre.imagen: Footprint of “Tower crane base”: a cross, 5.00 by 5.00 metres, marked with the letters “Bg”.

carga_suspendida.descripcion: A concrete skip, a pallet or a bundle of bars hanging from the crane hook, moving over the site. You hear the cable creak and people shouting warnings; never stay underneath.
carga_suspendida.imagen: Footprint of “Load hanging from the crane”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 1.20 metres, hanging 2.50 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Cs”.

puntal_forjado.descripcion: A vertical steel tube from floor to ceiling holding up a freshly poured slab. They usually stand in rows a metre apart, like a forest of bars: the cane finds them, but the base plate trips you.
puntal_forjado.imagen: Footprint of “Steel prop”: a rectangle, 0.15 by 0.15 metres, marked with the letters “Pf”.

andamio_borriquetas.descripcion: Two or three iron trestles with planks on top, at waist or chest height, for working inside a storey. The planks overhang at the ends and the cane goes underneath.
andamio_borriquetas.imagen: Footprint of “Trestle scaffold”: a rectangle, 2.50 by 0.80 metres, marked with the letters “Ab”.

barandilla_sargento.descripcion: A guardrail of tubes or planks clamped to the edge of the slab or stair, with a rail at hip height, another at knee height and a toe board. It is all that stands between you and the drop: do not lean on it hard.
barandilla_sargento.imagen: Footprint of “Temporary edge guardrail”: a rectangle, 2.50 by 0.15 metres, marked with the letters “Bs”.

rampa_tablones.descripcion: Planks nailed together with cross battens to bridge a level change on site. No handrail; they flex and sound hollow underfoot, and the battens act as steps.
rampa_tablones.imagen: Footprint of “Plank ramp”: a rectangle, 0.80 by 3.00 metres, marked with the letters “Rt”.

cuadro_electrico_obra.descripcion: A thick plastic box on a stand or hung on a column at chest height, with big sockets feeding cables across the floor. It hums slightly; you step on the cables.
cuadro_electrico_obra.imagen: Footprint of “Site distribution board”: a rectangle, 0.50 by 0.40 metres, marked with the letters “Ce”.

cable_colgado_obra.descripcion: A thick cable strung from column to column at neck or face height to keep it off the floor. It gives a little when you hit it, but the cane misses it.
cable_colgado_obra.imagen: Footprint of “Hanging site cable”: a rectangle, 5.00 by 0.03 metres, hanging 1.60 metres above the floor, marked with the letters “Cc”.

cofre_herramientas_obra.descripcion: A large, very heavy steel box with a hinged lid and padlock, knee or hip high. Opened, the lid stands up at head height.
cofre_herramientas_obra.imagen: Footprint of “Site tool vault”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 0.60 metres, marked with the letters “Ch”.

hueco_forjado.descripcion: A hole in the floor of a storey under construction: a light well, a services shaft or an unbuilt stair. It should be covered with nailed boards or fenced; if not, the cane stops finding floor and there is a whole storey below.
hueco_forjado.aviso: Floor opening! A drop to the floor below. Stop.
hueco_forjado.imagen: Footprint of “Floor opening”: a rectangle, 1.50 by 1.50 metres, marked with the letters “Hf”.

borde_forjado.descripcion: The floor of the storey ends in a drop because the façade is not built yet. There is usually a net or a guardrail; you feel the air and hear the street. Beyond the edge there is nothing.
borde_forjado.aviso: Slab edge: a drop to the outside. Stop.
borde_forjado.imagen: Footprint of “Open slab edge”: a rectangle, 5.00 by 0.50 metres, marked with the letters “Bf”.

hueco_ascensor_obra.descripcion: A vertical concrete shaft through every storey; on each floor there is a door-wide opening closed off with a rail or a plank. Inside, the void and the echo.
hueco_ascensor_obra.aviso: Lift shaft: a drop of several storeys. Stop.
hueco_ascensor_obra.imagen: Footprint of “Lift shaft under construction”: a rectangle, 1.80 by 1.80 metres, marked with the letters “Ha”.

escalera_obra_sin_barandilla.descripcion: A flight of rough concrete stairs with uneven steps and no handrail on the open side, or just a temporary rope or tube. Each nosing is rough; on the open side you fall.
escalera_obra_sin_barandilla.aviso: Building-site stair with no handrail on the open side.
escalera_obra_sin_barandilla.imagen: Footprint of “Unfinished stair without handrail”: a rectangle, 1.20 by 3.50 metres, marked with the letters “Eo”.

borde_vaciado.descripcion: The edge of the big basement excavation: the earth ground ends at a slope or a wall several metres deep. It is usually fenced, but not always; the loose earth at the edge crumbles underfoot.
borde_vaciado.aviso: Edge of the excavation: a drop of several metres. Stop.
borde_vaciado.imagen: Footprint of “Excavation edge”: a rectangle, 10.00 by 1.00 metres, marked with the letters “Bv”.
